tok 1.0 "3D model printing"

pool org "Customer"
  lane cust "Customer"
    start s "Model needed"
    task sketch "Send sketches to the artist"
    task change "Tell the artist what to change"
    xor satisfied "Satisfied with the result?"
    task choose "Choose a plastic color"
    xor instock "Color in stock?"
    task checkleft "Check how much color is left"
    xor under "Under 100 grams?"
    task list "Put the color on the shopping list"
    task order "Order the color"
    xor merge1 
    xor merge2
    and split
    task heat "Turn on the printer and heat up the bed and extruder"
    task gcode "Generate the gcode file from the STL"
    and join
    task print "Print the model"
    end e "Model printed"

flow s -> sketch -> change -> satisfied
flow satisfied -> change "no"
flow satisfied -> choose "yes"
flow choose -> instock
flow instock -> checkleft "yes"
flow instock -> order "no"
flow checkleft -> under
flow under -> list "yes"
flow under -> merge1 "no"
flow list -> merge1
flow merge1 -> merge2
flow order -> merge2
flow merge2 -> split
flow split -> heat
flow split -> gcode
flow heat -> join
flow gcode -> join
flow join -> print -> e
